name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan) Grilled Turkey Steak or Roast Turkey Dinner with Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: A classic Cache Valley diner staple: tender grilled turkey steak or carved roast turkey with whipped mashed potatoes, dinner roll, and chicken noodle soup.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Steak or Roast Turkey Dinner with mashed potatoes (gravy on the side), a baked dinner roll with honey butter, and a cup of Chicken Noodle Soup instead of tossed salad.
watchOuts: Choose Chicken Noodle Soup over the raw iceberg dinner salad
